question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Author's explanatory remarks at the beginning of a book
solution: The correct answer is: **Preface** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A **preface **is a short introductory statement written by the author of a book, explaining its purpose, scope, and background. (किसी पुस्तक के लेखक द्वारा लिखा गया एक संक्षिप्त परिचयात्मक वक्तव्य, जो उसके उद्देश्य, दायरे और पृष्ठभूमि को समझाता है) • It usually appears at the beginning of the book, before the main text. • A preface can also include acknowledgements, dedications, and other information related to the book's creation. • **Example**: *The author wrote a heartfelt preface to introduce the inspiration behind the novel.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Foreword **refers to a short introductory statement written by someone other than the author, usually a famous person or expert, endorsing the book and its author. (प्रस्तावना) • **Bibliography **is a list of sources consulted or cited in the book, usually appearing at the end. (ग्रन्थसूची) • **Biography **is a written account of someone's life, usually written by someone else. (जीवनी) 3f:T4db,The correct answer is: **The victims of the violence were treated very carefully by the doctor.**
